ns2:section.sectionText: This course will focus on the foundational concepts and skills of programming through visual design challenges, including bitmap manipulation and gesture-based interactions. At the end of this class, students will be empowered to use coding as a form of creative expression and be able to code interactive digital canvases for the web. The programming language used will be JavaScript. Undergraduate section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences, Art & Design, or College of Media Programs department.
